items.title: Milky Mist zooms 9.5% as Q1 profit surges multi-fold, up 65% over IPO price
items.description: Milk Mist, which listed on the bourses on August 18 after a solid response to its initial public offering (IPO), trades 65 per cent above its offer price of ₹140 based on today's intraday high.

items.title: Skyways Air Services shares defy GMP expectations, list at 10% discount
items.description: Skyways Air Services' shares debuted at ₹124 apiece on the National Stock Exchange, a 10.14 per cent discount to the initial public offer (IPO) price of ₹138 apiece.
